claims.quote: the Scottish Government is one of the most centralised devolved administrations in Europe
claims.statement: The Scottish Government is one of the most centralised devolved administrations in Europe.

claims.quote: with Holyrood not giving people who know their areas best enough of a say
claims.statement: Holyrood does not give people who know their areas best enough of a say.

claims.quote: pushing more power out of both Westminster and Holyrood, unlocking jobs and opportunity in every region
claims.statement: Pushing more power out of both Westminster and Holyrood would unlock jobs and opportunity in every region.

claims.quote: the next stage of devolution should place more decision-making in the hands of Scotland’s regions and cities to drive reindustrialisation
claims.statement: The next stage of devolution should place more decision-making in the hands of Scotland's regions and cities to drive reindustrialisation.
Through No10 North, the government is rewiring the state.

claims.quote: there is no limit to what we can achieve for the Scottish people
claims.statement: With the Scottish Government and UK Government working together, there is no limit to what can be achieved for the Scottish people.

claims.quote: Devolution has done a great deal
claims.statement: Devolution has done a great deal.

claims.quote: power was never supposed to stop at the doors of the Scottish Parliament
claims.statement: Power was never supposed to stop at the doors of the Scottish Parliament.

claims.quote: People in North Lanarkshire, in Fife or in the Highlands know what their communities need better than any minister
claims.statement: People in North Lanarkshire, Fife and the Highlands know what their communities need better than any minister, whether in London or Edinburgh.

claims.quote: the Scotland Office is ready to roll up its sleeves alongside them to make it happen
claims.statement: The Scotland Office is ready to work alongside the Scottish Government to make the offer happen.

claims.quote: Two governments, one goal - good jobs and real opportunity in every corner of Scotland.
claims.statement: The UK and Scottish governments share one goal: good jobs and real opportunity in every corner of Scotland.

facts.quote: the Prime Minister will invite Scotland’s First Minister to work with him
facts.statement: The Prime Minister intends to invite the First Minister to work with him.

facts.quote: after speaking with young people today in Lanarkshire
facts.statement: The Prime Minister spoke with young people in Lanarkshire.

facts.quote: he will call on the Scottish Government to work with the UK Government through No10 North and the Scotland Office
facts.statement: The Prime Minister intends to call on the Scottish Government to work with the UK Government through No10 North and the Scotland Office.

facts.quote: During my first week in office, I told the First Minister that I wanted to work with him
facts.statement: The Prime Minister told the First Minister that he wanted to work with him.

facts.quote: This is me making an offer to the Scottish Government.
facts.statement: The Prime Minister said he was making an offer to the Scottish Government.

facts.quote: The Scottish Secretary, Douglas Alexander said:
facts.statement: Douglas Alexander, the Scottish Secretary, made a statement on the offer.
